channel.name: CBBC UK
channel.title: Aloha Scooby-Doo!
channel.desc: Scooby and the Mystery Inc gang head to Hawaii for a big surfing contest that is disrupted by the rumblings of a nearby volcano and the disappearance of one of the surfers. They romp through the jungle, snorkel, paraglide and surf as they contend with the mysterious appearance of the Wiki Tiki and try to solve the mystery before the volcano erupts.
